title: How to Clean Fuel Injectors at Home
content:
If your car is feeling sluggish or struggling with rough idling, you might be dealing with clogged fuel injectors. Over time, fuel deposits can build up in the injectors, affecting their ability to spray fuel efficiently into the combustion chamber.
Knowing how to clean fuel injectors — and doing so regularly — can improve performance and fuel economy, as well as extend the life of your vehicle's engine.

Instead of replacing your fuel injectors right away, try cleaning them with the right products and techniques. A good injector cleaning can help restore proper function without the need for costly repairs.
